CHRONOS · OBSERVER FRAMES

A fly in a meadow,
viewed through three frames.

A single running simulation — one fly, one meadow — with modeled activity displayed on a verified subcircuit from the HHMI Janelia male central nervous system. CHRONOS rules control needs, decisions, and physics. Everything runs locally; nothing goes to the cloud.

  • WORLD — god view. See the fly, the meadow, and the brain panel at once.
  • FLY — first-person. See only what the fly's antennae and airflow sensors can report.
  • BLOCK — the whole worldline across time. Lesion events become visible as red segments.
  • BRANCH — a BLOCK-view experiment with four futures: baseline, sated, exhausted, and scrambled pathway weights.
